desc:
💥 Throw TNT, blast the ground apart, level up, and throw farther in +1 TNT Skipping!

⚡ Every bounce and every blast gives you Skill!
💪 Train and level up to throw farther!
🏆 Reach farther zones to earn more Wins!
🧨 Unlock better TNT and wild things to throw... even a MARSHMALLOW!
🐾 Hatch eggs and collect pets for powerful boosts!
🎲 Roll rare throws like MEGA BLAST and BIG BANG!
🌍 Explore 4 worlds: TNT Valley, Pirate Isles, Rocket Moon and Fudge Factory!
🔄 Rebirth to grow stronger and beat your longest throw!

👍 Like & Favorite if you enjoy the game!
